title: Eval runners cap concurrent headless sessions
body:
Source: t-ahsmyfp measurement (.krn/runs/lead/usage/report-before-v3.md): the week's concurrency peak of 69 sessions (2026-11-12 19:46Z) was headless sdk-cli sessions in .krn/worktrees/d23-requirements (516 sessions, judge and requirements prompts); no launcher script is in the repo; KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE counts worktrees and does not bind them.
Outcome: every eval runner that starts headless claude sessions (evals/replay once S6 ships, any d23 script) takes a host-wide session slot capped by KRN_EVAL_MAX_SESSIONS (default 4) and prints the wait; a test asserts at most N concurrent sessions with N=2 on a stub claude.
Proof: node --test test/evals/session-cap.test.ts: pass
Files: evals/replay/, evals/d23/
